 for label in ['upper','lower']:

 param('shaft_bore_trial','8 mm')

 for c,n,x,down,y,od,hub in [(ac,'20T','hip_spacing/2','0 mm','y_belt-belt_w/2','pd_s-1.14 mm-6 mm','20 mm'),(kc,'30T','0 mm','0 mm','-belt_w/2','pd_l-1.14 mm-6 mm','pulley_hub_D_trial')]:
  s=sk(c,'AZN_C6_'+n+'_pocket_sk','Y',y);circle(s,x,down,od);circle(s,x,down,hub)
  extrude(c,s,'AZN_C6_'+n+'_pocket','belt_w-3 mm',cut=[body(c,'AZN_C3_20T_GT_envelope' if n=='20T' else 'AZN_C4_30T_GT_envelope')])
 D.computeAll()

 rho=result['density_g_cm3'];result['mass_g_30']=rho*(shellv+.30*(v0-shellv));result['mass_g_40']=rho*(shellv+.40*(v0-shellv))

def run(_context:str):
 def section(c,name,z,body_names):
  s=sk(c,name,'Z',z)
  for b in c.bRepBodies:
   if b.name in body_names:s.projectCutEdges(b)
  s.isLightBulbOn=False
  out=[]
  for p in s.profiles:
   ap=p.areaProperties(adsk.fusion.CalculationAccuracy.HighCalculationAccuracy)
   out.append({'area_mm2':ap.area*100,'centroid_mm':[ap.centroid.x*10,ap.centroid.y*10],'I_cm4':list(ap.getCentroidMomentsOfInertia()),'loops':p.profileLoops.count})
  return s,out
 ac=occ('FL_abad_link').component;hc=occ('FL_hip_link').component;kc=occ('FL_knee_link').component
 su,pu=section(ac,'AZN_C6_U_section','30 mm',['AZN_C2_top_bridge'])
 p=next(p for p in su.profiles if p.areaProperties().centroid.x<ev('165 mm'))
 ap=p.areaProperties(adsk.fusion.CalculationAccuracy.HighCalculationAccuracy);I=ap.getCentroidMomentsOfInertia()[2]*10000
 xmin=min(pc.sketchEntity.boundingBox.minPoint.x for loop in p.profileLoops for pc in loop.profileCurves)
 xmax=max(pc.sketchEntity.boundingBox.maxPoint.x for loop in p.profileLoops for pc in loop.profileCurves)
 cmax=max(ap.centroid.x-xmin,xmax-ap.centroid.x)*10;sf=167*I/(5297.4*cmax)
 st,pt=section(hc,'AZN_C6_thigh_section','-100 mm',['AZN_C3_inner_plate','AZN_C3_outer_plate'])
 pc=adsk.core.ObjectCollection.create()
 for p in st.profiles:pc.add(p)
 apt=D.areaProperties(pc);It=apt.getCentroidMomentsOfInertia()[2]*10000
 ss,ps=section(kc,'AZN_C6_shank_section','-100 mm',['AZN_C4_shank_box'])
 sn,pn=section(kc,'AZN_C6_neck_section','-25 mm',['AZN_C4_shank_box'])
 param('fdm_shell_trial','1.2 mm',comment='Three 0.4 mm perimeters; mass estimate, slicer confirmation required')
 param('fdm_infill_trial','0.35','',comment='35 percent in eligible straight shank material core only; hub, neck and foot bridge kept dense')
 param('fdm_core_span_trial','130 mm',comment='Local Z -180 to -50 mm, uniform hollow shank; dense end regions')
 W=ev('shank_W_trial')*10;B=ev('shank_B_trial')*10;t=ev('shank_wall_trial')*10;skin=ev('fdm_shell_trial')*10
 Aall=W*B-(W-2*t)*(B-2*t)
 Ashell=W*B-(W-2*skin)*(B-2*skin)+(W-2*t+2*skin)*(B-2*t+2*skin)-(W-2*t)*(B-2*t)
 core=(Aall-Ashell)*ev('fdm_core_span_trial')*10/1000
 b=next(b for b in kc.bRepBodies if b.name=='AZN_C4_shank_box');mass=b.physicalProperties.mass*1000;rho=mass/b.volume
 b.attributes.add('AZN','PrintSpecification','1.2 mm skins/perimeters, 30-40% core in local Z -180..-50; hub/neck/foot bridge dense. CAD density unchanged.')
 out={'U_profiles':pu,'U_Iy_mm4':I,'U_c_mm':cmax,'U_SF_nominal':sf,'thigh_profiles':pt,'thigh_Iy_mm4':It,'thigh_SF_Kt2':167*It/(2*11469.207*14),'shank_profiles':ps,'neck_profiles':pn,'print':{'solid_PETG_g':mass,'full_section_mm2':Aall,'shell_section_mm2':Ashell,'eligible_core_cm3':core,'mass_30_g':mass-rho*core*.7,'mass_40_g':mass-rho*core*.6,'density_g_cm3':rho}}
 print(json.dumps(out))
